newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets Mannesmann/Deutsche Bahn DBKom venture.
newsitem.headline: EU vets Mannesmann/Deutsche Bahn DBKom venture.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was vetting a telecommunications joint venture between Mannesmann AG and German railway company Deutsche Bahn AG (DB).

The venture, called DBKom, is to acquire the exclusive right to use the ground alongside DB's tracks for the construction of telecoms infrastructure until December 31, 2015, the Commission said in a notice published in the Official Journal C357.

The deal is in line with the Commission's decision to force EU states to allow the use of infrastructure owned by utilities and railways to offer telecoms services. The relevant legislation came into force last July.

The Commission said the DBKom deal was notified for EU clearance under regulaton 17/62 which bans restrictive practices and abuse of dominant position. There is no deadline for ruling on cases falling under such rules.
